rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is not fair or just.

example.english: The way this match was judged is really unfair.
example.traditional: 呢個比賽咁樣判，真係唔公平。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 bei2 coi3 gam2 joeng2 pun3 zan1 hai6 m4 gung1 ping4

rows.note: Pick this especially when judging unfair treatment, a deal, or someone’s conduct as unjust.

example.english: The way you treat the newcomer is really unfair.
example.traditional: 你咁樣對個新人，真係唔公道。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 go3 san1 jan4 zan1 hai6 m4 gung1 dou6
